Identified as this saint because: Found by route 1, the category built from the folder's own name: Commons has Category:Arsenius of Elassona and this is its one portrait-sized image of the man rather than of his gospel book. 627x746. He is the Greek archbishop of Elassona who died at Suzdal in 1626, and the donor icon shows him as donor; the other eight files in the category are pages of his 1608-9 gospels in the Kremlin, his reliquary casket, and a facsimile of his signature, none of which are him. There is one Arsenius of Elassona and the category is titled for him. Commons describes it: Donor Icon of  Arseniy of Elasson
